content: Fɩtátɔ Futí Kɩ
Mɩ́ apíó, nɩ́ mlɩlahɔ numnyam Owíe Yesu Kristo gyi a, mlɩmáfutí fɩtátɔ kɩ.

Nɩ́ ɩwɩ onyapʋ́á ɔdɩdɩ́ tatiá ɩbʋ ibíá, ɔlɔwa sika atɔ́ pʋ́ ohiániá ɔdɩdɩ́ tatida bɛbá mlɩ Bulu osúmkpá a, mlɩmáha ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ ámʋ otsiákpá, bláa mʋ mlɩaa, obétsiá oyilékpá nfɩ; bláa ohiáni ámʋ mʋ́ mlɩaa, otsía asɩ ɔtɩnɛkʋ ɩnʋ, ntɛ́ɛ odúnka ɔtɩnɛkʋ lɩɩ.
Nɩ́ mlobú ahá amʋ́ ɩwɩnya sʋ á, mlɩmɔ́kʋ́pʋ́ agywɩɩn laláhɛ gyi asʋ́n nɩ́?

Apíó adwɛpʋ́, mlɩyaa asʋ amlɩnu. Bulu lɛ́lɛ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ ahiánfɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋnyáa hógyi ánɩ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bʋ ɔnlɩn, abʋtsia mʋ iwíegyí ámʋtɔ, fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛhɩɛ yáɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɔ́pʋhá ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋtɔdwɛ́ mʋ amʋ.
Támɛ mlɩ mʋ́ á, mlɩtɔkpɔ́ɩ́ ahiánfɔ. Nfɩ́tɛ mlɩ, megyí ɩwɩ anyapʋ́ ánfɩ tesísi mlɩ, tswɩ́n mlɩ mánsʋ, sáma mlɩ wúlu ahandɛ wá nɩ́?
Megyí amʋ́ dɛ́ Kristo ɩdayilé ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩdɩn mlɩsʋ ámʋ kpɔɩ́ nɩ́?
Bulu mbla ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ nwun, bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ gyí, “Dwɛ fʋ́ bá fɛ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩ.” Nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́sʋ́ gyi lɛ́lɛ́ á, mʋ́mʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ ɩtɔ wankláán bwɛ.
Támɛ nɩ́ mlofútí fɩtátɔ kɩ a, mlɩlabwɛ́ lakpan. Bulu mbla ámʋ lahá mlɩ ɩpɔ́n.
Tsúfɛ́ fʋ́á fegyi mbla ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́, támɛ fɛpán kʋlɛ pɛ́ á, fagyi pɔ́n ánɩ́ fatʋ́n mbla ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́.
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mátɔ mbʋa.” Mʋ kɛ́n lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mámɔ ɔha” ɛ́ nɩ́. Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ fʋmɔkʋ́tɔ́ mbʋa, támɛ famɔ́ ɔha a, fʋmɔkʋ́kíná Bulu mblasʋ gyí nɩ?
Bulu ɔbɔ́pʋ mbla ánfɩ́ ɩtɛhá anɩtegyi ɩwɩ ánfɩ gyi ahá asʋ́n. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩkɩ wankláán, mlɩ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ pʋ́ mlɩ bwɛhɛ́tɔ́.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtamawun ahá nwɛ á, Bulu omóowun mʋ nwɛ. Támɛ nɩ́ fʋtowun ahá nwɛ á, Bulu obówun fʋ nwɛ mʋ asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́.
Hógyi Pʋ́ Bwɛhɛ́
Apíó aba, nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mɔhɔ Bulu gyi, támɛ mʋ bwɛhɛ́ mosuná alɩ á, labi mɔmʋ mʋ hógyi amʋ bʋ? Mʋ́ odu ɩbɛ́talɩ́ há mʋ ɔkláa obénya nkpa?

Nɩ́ fowun fʋ́ aba akʋ bʋma atɔ dɩdáhɛ́ pʋ́ ɔyɩ kɛhɛtɔ atogyihɛ, támɛ fʋmɛha amʋ́, fɛbláa amʋ́ fɛɛ, “Nɛhá mlɩ itsiá. Mlɩtsia wankláán. Bulu ɔkpáa mlɩ, ɔha mlɩ tɔ́á ɩdɛ mlɩ hián” a, labi mɔmʋ fʋ́ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ amʋ ɩlɔwa?
Alɩ́ hógyi igyi nɩ́. Hógyi oduá yilébwɛ há fʋ́ bá ɩma mʋ́tɔ́ á, igyi hógyi wúhɛ́.
Ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́talɩ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Fʋbʋ hógyi. Mɩ́ ɛ́ ntɔbwɛ́ yilé.” Nɛ́lɛ bláa mʋ mbɛ́ɛ, “Suna mɩ́ fʋ́ hógyi amʋ́ʋ́ yilébwɛ ɩma mʋ́tɔ́ ámʋ. Mɩ́ ɛ́ nósuná fʋ́ mɩ́ hógyi tsú mɩ́ yilébwɛtɔ́.”
Fʋ́ hógyi desuná ánɩ́ Bulu ɔkʋlɛ pɛ́ bʋ ɩnʋ? Ɩbʋ alɛ́! Támɛ bɩ ánɩ́ ɔŋɛ laláhɛ fɛ́ɛ́ bohogyi alɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ bʋtenyá mʋ ifú, kpɩ́nkɩ́ kpakpakpakpa.
Fʋ́ ɔha mimláhɛ, fʋdekléá fówun ánɩ́ hógyiá ɩtamabwɛ́ yilé igyi hógyi kpaalɩ?
Anɩ náin Abraham lɔ́bwɛ yilé Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, tsúfɛ́ olotsulá kpá mʋ bi Isak yáa pututɔ, tɛkɩ ɔyɔ́mɔ mʋ bɔ́ afɔdɩɛ há Bulu.
Mlɩlawun alɩá nanáin Abraham hógyi pʋ́ mʋ bwɛhɛ́ lɛnatɩ́? Mʋ bwɛhɛ́ sʋ mʋ hógyi lɔfʋn.
Alɩ́ Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ anfɩ ɩlɛba mʋ́tɔ́ nɩ́. Ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Abraham lɔ́hɔ Bulu gyi. Mʋ́ sʋ́ Bulu lóbu mʋ yilé ɔbwɛpʋ́,” tɩ́ mʋ mʋ nyawie nɩ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ séi á, mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ yilébwɛ tɛ́há Bulu totsú ɔha ánɩ́ mʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́, megyí mʋ hógyi pɛ́.
Alɩ́ ɩlɛba ha obu-ɔnɔ́ otsiápʋ́ Rahab ɛ́ nɩ́. Bulu lótsu mʋ ánɩ́ mʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa, tsú tɔ́á ɔlɔbwɛ sʋ. Ɔlɔpʋ Yudafɔ akʋá bɛba bʋdɛ ansɩ́ wa kɩ mʋ ɔmátɔ́ ŋáín, ɔlɛha amʋ́ bɛtsɛ ɔkpa srɩ́.
Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔŋɛ́ ɩma ɔhatɔ ógyi itowuhɛ́ ámʋ a, alɩ nɩ́ yilébwɛ mɛmá hógyisʋ ɛ́ igyi hógyi wúhɛ́ nɩ.
